nodes.label: Agent Workflow Design Spec 2026-05-11
nodes.rationale: Adopted shared repo-owned coordination layer at agent-workflow/ to prevent drift across multiple AI models (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot). Chosen over per-model memory because one canonical source reduces token cost, prevents stale parallel docs, and allows one model to continue another model's work.

nodes.label: Shiny Batch Analysis Design Spec 2026-05-11
nodes.rationale: Adopts one canonical Shiny-side analysis config builder so validation, run, local-data diagnostics, code preview, and script export all consume the same normalized configuration. This eliminates script preview drift and prevents batch-mode session disconnect caused by residual single-period assumptions.
